title: XDG state-home resolution reimplemented with drifting fallbacks
note: Confirmed: doctor/statedir.go:30-37 and agent/runtime_dir.go:73-83 fall back to os.TempDir(); cmdutil/statedir.go:30-80 falls back to '.' and returns the root with /evener appended. Drift only matters when home is unresolvable, so impact is low. Doctor also has EVENER_STATE_DIR precedence cmdutil documents it does NOT honor (cmdutil/statedir.go:21), so the shared helper must stay at the XDG layer only.
revised_fix_plan: Share only the XDG-or-home/.local/state step in envvars/userdirs; leave precedence arms per caller; ask Jesse which fallback wins.

title: events double-registers kind and payload; dead pointer arms and ToStreamEvent
note: Confirmed: Session.emit(kind, data) (session_events.go:231) takes both and sendEventContext calls events.New(data) ignoring kind except enrichDiagnosticData and kind==EventWarning; about 250 emit sites (not 252); 12 'case *events.' arms; 56 '_ EventData =' lines in eventdata.go; ToStreamEvent used only in agent/sdk_alignment_test.go. Wrong: ToStreamEvent is NOT the sole reason events imports llm (events/payloads.go:11 also imports it), so no import is dropped.
revised_fix_plan: Derive kind from payload via exported events.KindOf; mechanical rewrite of emit sites; delete pointer arms and ToStreamEvent plus its test. Do not claim the llm import goes away.

title: Constant-true Profile capability methods and a 10_000 sentinel that overrides an explicit timeout
note: session_init.go:357 overrides when cfg value == 10_000, which applyDefaults sets (session_config.go:967), so an explicit 10000 becomes 120000. Profile methods return constants (profile.go:258-265). Production branches at session_stream.go:170, session_tool_round.go:134, session_model_call.go:421,468,1277. Note applyDefaults is also called at session_init.go:968, and docs/job-control.md:385 states the 10000 ms fallback, so that doc must be updated.
revised_fix_plan: Red test for explicit 10000; move 120_000 into applyDefaults and delete the profile method plus override; inline the two always-true capability checks; update docs/job-control.md:385.

title: SessionConfig and schema.ConfigSnapshot mirrored field-for-field
note: Mirror confirmed (34 fields in config_snapshot.go; toSnapshot at session_config.go:1005, configFromSnapshot at :1049; hand Clone is on ConfigSnapshot, config_snapshot.go:51). But embedding ConfigSnapshot in SessionConfig breaks composite literals: Go cannot set promoted fields in SessionConfig{...}; repo has about 1810 'SessionConfig{' occurrences (11 non-test), so the embed plan is a huge churn. Round-trip test already guards the mirror.
revised_fix_plan: Keep both structs. Add a reflection test that every ConfigSnapshot field is copied by both converters and that Clone deep-copies every slice/map/pointer field. No embedding.
